description: This file implements the Session class for managing user confirmation UI sessions within the confui namespace. It handles session states, rendering dialogs, processing user input, error reporting, and session lifecycle management.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Manages a user confirmation session, including state transitions, dialog rendering, user input handling, and error reporting.

methods.name: GetGracePeriod
methods.description: Returns the grace period duration (at least 1 second plus alpha) before user input is accepted after dialog rendering.

methods.name: IsReadyForUserInput
methods.description: Checks if the session is ready to accept user input based on the elapsed time since dialog start.

methods.name: RenderDialog
methods.description: Requests the renderer to display the confirmation dialog.

methods.name: Transition
methods.description: Handles state transitions based on input and current session state.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Performs cleanup actions when ending a session, including setting mode back to Android.

methods.name: ScheduleToTerminate
methods.description: Schedules the session to terminate by changing its state.

methods.name: ReportErrorToHal
methods.description: Reports an error message to the HAL and schedules session termination.

methods.name: UserAbort
methods.description: Handles user-initiated aborts, sending appropriate commands and scheduling termination.

methods.name: HandleInit
methods.description: Handles the initial state of the session, starting the session upon receiving the correct command.

methods.name: HandleInSession
methods.description: Processes user input during an active session, including signing responses.

methods.name: HandleWaitStop
methods.description: Handles the wait stop state, responding to HAL commands to stop or abort the session.
